comment: Actuals-loop constants (phase E4, v0.7.0) - nothing hard-coded in romtool/actuals.py. Drift ratio per catalog row = unit actual hours / unit norm-card mid hours (mid minutes / 60); the report-level ratio is qty-weighted (sum of actual hours / sum of norm mid-hours at the row qtys) and the proposal uses the weighted MEDIAN of per-row ratios (robust to one bad field report). quality flag bands on |drift_pct|.
min_rows_note: A proposal needs at least this many valid actual rows (qty>0, hours>0) per catalog card - one field report is an observation, not a refit basis.
guard_note: Proposal guard: the proposed card is norm low/high scaled by the median ratio, with the median ratio clamped into [guard_ratio_low, guard_ratio_high] of the current norm before scaling. Proposals NEVER auto-apply; POST .../apply-refit writes owner-approved numbers to config/company_labor_overrides.json.
apply_note: apply-refit accepts owner-approved low/high (both > 0, high > low). It writes the company override layer and logs an audit event on the applying estimate; every later compute prefers the override card (provenance stamped on affected recap lines and company_override_catalog_ids).

defaults.note: Rows without a date are rejected; dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD. cost is optional ($); hours and qty are required > 0.
